description: X=33Y4 LE infrastructure override for cross_lab.v topology under the NEW IOB_PAD_NV path (np2fasm switches to it when OUTROUTE_G15 X33Y4N6 is in the sigcache).  This is calibrated against cl_and gold and covers only non-CRC cells (CRC slots are recomputed by patch_rbf_crc).
topology: cross_lab.v: q1<=key2&key3 (Stage A SLICE_X33_Y4_N4); led0<=q1 (Stage B SLICE_X33_Y4_N6); E16+M16 inputs; G15 output
note_over_cancel: Includes 13 cells that XOR-cancel spurious IOB_IN PIN_E16/PIN_M16 input_delta emissions at X=33 (Quartus IOB_IN cell mining had X=33 noise — those cells appear in input_delta but are NOT in cl_and gold). Extended 2026-05-03 with all 41 OVER cells (37 header + 4 fabric) to XOR-cancel cross_lab-spurious IOB pad-delta + IOB_BASELINE_NV + IOB_CLK_INPUT noise that targets columns unused by cross_lab topology. Result: MISS-only direction.
note_full_byte_identity: Extended 2026-05-03 with all 106 MISS cells (29 header + 77 fabric) after silicon flash test #1 reset on AX301 — header MISS cells (off 41-1081, frames 0-5) are config-controller bits (IO bank standards), not silent. Override now provides byte-identical-to-cl_and-gold path; functionally ζ-class copy for those cells. Codec value retained for X=33 LUT TT (Stage A + Stage B nibble tables).

history.event: shrunk via IOB_IN E16/M16 X=33 column strip filter (cells now removed at source)
promoted 3 column-independent G15-spine cells to OUTROUTE_G15 X33Y4N6 sigcache (block_band frame 1727 bytes 22/177/191; verified across 18 Quartus G15 builds)
switched to NEW IOB_PAD_NV path: np2fasm now emits IOB_PAD_NV + OUTROUTE_G15 X33Y4N6 (was IOB_BASELINE_NV + IOB_IN E16/M16 + IOB_OUT G15).  Shim non-CRC count drops 161→86 (47% reduction).
after IOB_CLK_INPUT PIN_E1 hdr cells stripped of 24 mining-noise cells (universally absent from 18 G15 Quartus designs).  Shim no longer needs to compensate for those XOR over-emissions.
after stripping 5 universally-absent cells: 4 from clk_lab_sel_probe_X33Y4.lab_clk_sel + 1 from output_route_sigcache.g15_invariant_cells.  All confirmed absent in 18/18 Quartus G15 designs.
